units.text: One participant said the garden was the only place she felt calm all week. The garden opens on weekday mornings only, which excludes people who work.
Sessions are free, but tool hire was charged at the start of the project. Participants learned to propagate seedlings and to read a planting calendar.
The garden shares a site with a primary school. Funding came from a three-year council grant that ends in March.
